title: Points Caps and Top-Off Allowances of the Free Night Awards
content:
Each of the six Free Night Awards pays one standard-room night. What an award covers is measured against the night's standard-room points price; the cap is the highest such price the award covers without any points added, and top-off is the points a member may add from the member's own Ashbury Rewards account when a night is priced above the cap.

## Schedule by award type

| Award type | Points cap per night | Uncapped | Top-off permitted | Most top-off points per award | Nights paid per award |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25K Free Night Award | 25000 | No | Yes | 15000 | 1 |
| 35K Free Night Award | 35000 | No | Yes | 15000 | 1 |
| 40K Free Night Award | 40000 | No | Yes | 15000 | 1 |
| 50K Free Night Award | 50000 | No | Yes | 15000 | 1 |
| 85K Free Night Award | 85000 | No | Yes | 15000 | 1 |
| Any Hotel Free Night Award | 0 (no cap) | Yes | No | 0 | 1 |

Terms common to every award type:

- **Price compared with the cap:** the standard-room points price of the night.
- **Peak-season nights:** usable on peak-season nights within the cap, for every award type.
- **Source of top-off points:** top-off points must come from the award holder's own account, for every award type.

## Notes on the terms

1. The points cap is the highest standard-room points price of a night that the award covers with no top-off. The Any Hotel Free Night Award carries a cap of 0 because it is uncapped: it covers a standard room at any eligible hotel whatever the night's points price.
2. Top-off means points from the member's account added to cover a night priced above the cap. The most top-off points that may be added to one award is the figure in the schedule; the Any Hotel Free Night Award permits no top-off, and its limit is 0.
3. One award pays one night. A stay of several nights paid with Free Night Awards uses one award per award night.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical prices)

The highest night price a capped award reaches with its full top-off allowance is its cap together with its most top-off points:

| Award type | Cap | Full top-off allowance | Highest night price reached with full top-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25K Free Night Award | 25000 | 15000 | 40000 |
| 35K Free Night Award | 35000 | 15000 | 50000 |
| 50K Free Night Award | 50000 | 15000 | 65000 |

- A hypothetical night priced at 25000 points is within the cap of the 25K Free Night Award; no top-off arises.
- A hypothetical night priced at 31000 points is 6000 points above the cap of the 25K Free Night Award; 6000 is within the 15000 allowance.
- A hypothetical night priced at 41000 points is 16000 points above the cap of the 25K Free Night Award, more than the 15000 allowance.
- Under the Any Hotel Free Night Award the hypothetical night price, whatever it is, is covered without any top-off.
